findings: Changing the idempotency-key format without backward compatibility can cause retries of an already-created checkout to use a new key and be processed as a distinct operation, potentially creating duplicate checkouts or charges.
evidence: The key changes from `${orderId}:${attemptNumber}` to `${orderId}|${attemptNumber}`; the same request inputs therefore produce a different idempotency key after deployment.
gaps: No evidence of a migration, dual-read/compatibility strategy, or confirmation that previously issued idempotency keys cannot be retried during the provider's retention window.
